messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] crashes with gpoisson likelihood
parts:
Hi,

the error says that you run out of memory for some reason. The
question is why. Normally this is because the latent model is to
large, for which you can check by running the same model with
'poisson' instead of 'gpoisson'. I check the code for 'gpoisson' and
there is no memory leaks there (not any alloc at all), so its not for
that reason. (or running the model on a subset of the data)

Reading the documentation, there are quite some warnings about the
parameter 'p', maybe there should be a well defined prior like the PC-
prior constructed for it, but otherwise, please check if these 'notes'
might appear in your problem.

Otherwise, reducing the number of threads (num.threads=...) and
setting control.inla=list(strategy='adaptive',int.strategy='eb')
might help


Let me know.

H
